fetch_plan.reconstitution: Fetch only allowlisted paths at pinned commits. Verify descriptor, individual shard, compressed concatenation, and bounded decompressed SHA-256/size. Decode WAV PCM locally and verify PCM SHA/frame count. Never execute downloaded source before hash verification.

mandatory_restrictions: Do not git-clone or restore the entire data archive, because that includes donor/F20/unrequested model bytes.
Do not fetch development audio, donor, F20, historical logits, or a20.f32. Only the exact A20 checkpoint is a model payload.
Do not import original run_baseline.py or audited_sources(); accept_wave is lifted from the pinned public stream_kws_ctc.py.
Do not substitute a sanitized historical model/trainer excerpt for its original hash. Current preparation must use its reviewed new runner.
No optimizer, backward, training, decoder, development evaluation, threshold selection, or model download beyond the listed checkpoint.

rights.synthetic_audio: Fixed public Qwen stock-preset research batches; no third-party voice-clone reference identified in archived provenance.
rights.derived_outputs: Features and zero-update technical outputs inherit source provenance and restrictions. Public input availability does not itself authorize publishing newly derived artifacts; preserve attributions, source WAV/PCM SHA, generator revisions, weak/reviewed label categories, historical exposure, research-only status, and no qualification claims.
rights.public_output_publication_permission: Requires user-authorized bounded scope; not inferred by this mapping.
